items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 64:1
items.html: (To the question) What is Jacob? The Partzuf of the VAK of ZA, called the external Partzuf, is called by the name Jacob. And the Partzuf of the Mochin of ZA, which is the inner Partzuf that clothes within the Partzuf of the VAK, is called by the name Moses and Israel. (Item 177).
